sn12.18:3.2: When asked ‘Then are pleasure and pain made by another’, you say ‘not so’.
sn12.18:3.3: When asked ‘Well, are pleasure and pain made by both oneself and another’, you say ‘not so’.
sn12.18:3.4: When asked ‘Then do pleasure and pain arise anomalously, not made by oneself or another’, you say ‘not so’.
sn12.18:3.6: ‘There is such a thing as pleasure and pain, Timbaruka,’ you say.
sn12.18:3.7: When asked ‘then, does the worthy Gotama not know or see pleasure and pain’, you say ‘it’s not that I don’t know or see pleasure and pain.
